# DigiScience Techsol

> AI-first cloud transformation partner for secure, governed, industry-specific AI solutions on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.

DigiScience Techsol helps enterprise and mid-market teams assess AI readiness, choose practical first use cases, build secure cloud-hosted AI pilots, and add responsible AI governance before scaling. The company is based in New Delhi, India and serves global buyers in manufacturing, healthcare, legal, BFSI/insurance, logistics, HR/recruitment, retail, education, real estate, and public sector workflows.

For buyers who have a defined business or technology problem but have not chosen a solution, the DigiScience Solution Assessment compares workflow improvement, automation, AI, secure cloud, hybrid or on-premise deployment, platform modernization, and combined paths before implementation is scoped.

## Service Portfolio

- AI Strategy, Readiness and Transformation Advisory: opportunity prioritization, readiness scoring, target architecture, risk view, and executable transformation roadmap.
  - AI Readiness Assessment is the focused option for scoring use cases, data readiness, cloud readiness, security posture, responsible AI risk, business value, and pilot feasibility when AI is already the likely path.
- AI Industry Transformation Solutions: outcome-led AI workflows for prediction, document intelligence, knowledge access, assistants, agents, and operational decision support.
- 45-Day Industry AI Pilot: controlled proof of value for one high-priority AI workflow with architecture, governance controls, working pilot, success metrics, and scale roadmap.
- Secure Enterprise AI Cloud Platform: secure AI landing zones with IAM/RBAC, private networking, audit logging, monitoring, data classification, AI service access, and cost governance.
- Responsible AI Governance and Agent Control: prompt security, model risk controls, human approval, hallucination risk management, audit trail, agent permissions, and compliance mapping.
- AI-Ready DevOps and Platform Engineering: DevSecOps, MLOps, LLMOps, release approval, observability, and production support patterns for AI systems.
- Cloud Modernization for AI Readiness: targeted modernization required to make cloud, data, security, and delivery foundations ready for governed AI adoption.

## Engagement Model Snapshot

- DigiScience Solution Assessment: first five paid customers INR 29K / USD 349; standard INR 49K / USD 599. One defined problem, seven business days after required buyer inputs, 50% to begin and 50% before the final package. The full paid fee is credited toward a DigiScience implementation signed within 60 days.
- AI Readiness Assessment: a focused downstream option when the defined problem requires AI opportunity, readiness, governance, and pilot assessment.
- Focused AI Pilot: scoped after readiness and discovery.
- Department AI Accelerator: scoped programme for multiple workflows, integrations, and formal controls.
- Governed Enterprise AI Platform: custom programme for enterprise, regulated, hybrid, or private requirements.
- Managed AI Governance and Operations: monthly service scoped to production operating responsibility.

Cloud usage, LLM tokens, paid third-party tools, and unusually complex integrations are quoted separately after discovery.

## Factual Entity and Evidence Notes

- Public name: DigiScience Techsol.
- Legal name used in site structured data: Digiscience Techsol Private Limited.
- Delivery reach: based in New Delhi, India, serving buyers in India and globally.
- Leadership credibility: DigiScience is guided by senior technology leadership with more than 22 years of enterprise experience. The public site intentionally does not identify a named founder.
- Public proof policy: customer outcomes, logos, testimonials, and case studies are published only when supported by verified evidence and permission.
- The public Sample Solution Assessment uses a fictional, synthetic scenario to demonstrate work-product structure. It is not customer work, not a testimonial, not a claim of achieved results, and not a promised outcome.
- Reference architectures, blueprints, scorecards, checklists, and frameworks demonstrate delivery methods. They must not be described as completed client implementations.

## Priority Industries

- Manufacturing AI: predictive maintenance, quality intelligence, plant operations support, downtime reduction, production planning, and operator decision support.
- Healthcare AI: administrative workflow automation, patient support workflows, clinical documentation support, governed knowledge retrieval, and compliance-aware deployment.
- Legal Document Intelligence: contract review, clause extraction, obligation tracking, legal knowledge assistants, source-grounded answers, and reviewer workflows.
- BFSI and Insurance AI: compliance intelligence, claims triage, risk review, document automation, audit evidence, and governed decision support.
- Logistics AI: shipment exception intelligence, route and capacity insights, customer update automation, and operations workflow support.
- HR and Recruitment AI: candidate screening support, policy assistants, onboarding knowledge assistants, and human-reviewed workflow automation.
- Retail AI: demand intelligence, product support, customer service augmentation, merchandising insights, and operational analytics.

## Recommended First Step

For a new buyer with one defined business or technology problem, start with the DigiScience Solution Assessment. It is a bounded pre-implementation engagement, not full implementation or unlimited free consulting. It recommends whether the appropriate path is workflow improvement, automation, AI, secure cloud, hybrid or on-premise deployment, platform modernization, or a combination.
